queries_run: Amkor Technology market share gaining OR losing 2026
Amkor Technology new entrant OR displace threat advanced packaging 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 指出外包封測市場競爭激烈，地緣政治貿易緊張提高了中國業者（中國供中國）的競爭；主要對手為 ASE、JCET、Powertech，另有晶圓代工與 EMS 提供部分先進封裝，IDM 客戶亦評估自家產能。
findings.excerpt: The outsourced semiconductor packaging and test market is highly competitive, and geopolitical trade tensions have increased competition from Chinese firms supporting a China-for-China supply chain. We face competition from established packaging and test service providers primarily located in Asia, including ASE Technology, JCET Group and Powertech Technology.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：前十大客戶占 2025 年淨銷售 72%；亦可能面對受中國政府支持、資金成本較低的本地業者競爭，客戶可能轉用內部、晶圓代工或合約製造商。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers accounted for, in the aggregate, 72% of our net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到權威 2026 份額量測或具名新進入者搶單；僅第三方估計（CSIMarket 約 3.37% 封測市占，未核原文）。搜尋摘要提及 Q2 2026 前十大客戶占比 66%（vs 72%）、TSMC 於嘉義自建先進封裝、Intel/GF 擴產，均未讀到原文。

clues.claim: Amkor 年度資本支出最高約 $30 億，並提及 TSMC 自建先進封裝、Amkor 與 TSMC 協議
clues.source: TheNextWeb: Amkor will spend up to $3bn this year

clues.claim: Amkor Q2 2026 前十大客戶占淨銷售 66%，低於去年同期 72%
